_comment: Copy to config.json to start from this instead of the empty default. The panel writes config.json itself on first run, so you usually don't need this file at all. Stop the panel before editing config.json. Use double backslashes in Windows paths.
_backupsRoot_note: Optional. Where backups go. Left out, they sit in a 'backups' folder inside each world - handy, but on the same disk as the thing they are protecting.
_curseforgeKey_note: Optional. Free key from console.curseforge.com, so the Mods tab can search CurseForge. Modrinth needs no key. Easiest added from the Mods tab in the UI.
